notify_intro: Get sample outfit advice without opening the app. Notifications are scheduled only on your device.
notify_snapshot_note: DEMO: Content prepared when you save repeats weekly. No fresh weather is fetched. Save again after changing your wardrobe or language.
notify_web_note: Browser preview only; notifications are not scheduled. Test delivery in an iPhone/Android development build.
notify_best_effort: Delivery depends on notification permissions, Focus/Do Not Disturb and battery settings. The time is your device’s local time.
notify_message_dry: Open the app for your daily plan.
notify_empty: Add a few items to your wardrobe before scheduling outfit advice.
notify_test_sent: Test notification scheduled for 5 seconds from now; device delivery has not been verified.
notify_permission_denied: Notification permission was not granted. You can allow it in device settings and keep using the app.
notify_invalid: Choose a valid HH:MM time and at least one day.
notify_schedule_failed: Could not schedule notifications. The new plan is not marked active; you can try again.
notify_cancel_failed: Some old notifications could not be cancelled and may still arrive. Try turning them off again.
notify_storage_failed: Notification settings could not be stored. Changes are not considered saved or newly active.
notify_read_failed: Could not read notification settings. You can turn off the old device schedule or reopen this screen.
notify_status_inactive: Settings exist, but an active device schedule or permission could not be confirmed. Save again.
notify_remaining: Morning notifications still need to be cancelled on this device. Try turning them off again.
notify_unsaved: Changes take effect when you save.
notify_stale: Your wardrobe, language or sample weather changed. Save again to update the notification content.
notify_permission_prompt: Saving or testing may ask your device for notification permission. Permission is optional.
notify_error_settings: Could not open device settings. Check notification permissions in your phone’s Settings app.
